gloss: to utilize; to put to practical use

definitions.gloss: to utilize, to make use of, to put to practical use
definitions.explanation: To effectively use available resources, skills, knowledge, or opportunities for a practical purpose.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}を{活用|かつよう}する。
この{制度|せいど}をもっと{活用|かつよう}すべきだ。
examples.english: We should make better use of this system.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{資源|しげん}を{活用|かつよう}して、{新|あたら}しい{産業|さんぎょう}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す{取|と}り{組|く}みが{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Efforts to create new industries by utilizing local resources are progressing.

notes:
A compound of {活|かつ} (lively, active) and {用|よう} (use). Emphasizes making effective, productive use of something — not just using it, but leveraging it to its full potential. Very common in business, education, and policy contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資源|しげん}を{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize resources
- {人材|じんざい}を{活用|かつよう}する: to make use of human talent
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{活用|かつよう}する: to leverage technology
- データを{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize data
- {有効|ゆうこう}{活用|かつよう}: effective utilization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利用|りよう}する: to use, to utilize — more general; simply using something for a purpose
- {使用|しよう}する: to use — the most neutral and basic term for using something
- {駆使|くし}する: to make full use of, to command — implies mastery and skillful deployment

USAGE:
The noun {活用|かつよう} also has a grammatical meaning: verb conjugation. In Japanese grammar studies, {活用|かつよう} refers to how verbs and adjectives change form.
